sections.title: Albuquerque's emerging technology ecosystem
sections.description: Albuquerque's technology market is shaped by the unique combination of national laboratory research and diverse regional enterprise.

blocks.heading: Sandia's commercialization engine
paragraphs: Sandia's 14,000+ scientists and engineers and $4B+ annual budget generate a substantial technology transfer pipeline — the laboratory's innovations in microelectronics, energy, materials science, and cybersecurity create licensing and commercialization opportunities that Albuquerque startups and established companies have been increasingly successful in commercializing.

blocks.heading: New Mexico's bilingual healthcare imperative
paragraphs: New Mexico's 47% Hispanic/Latino population and significant Native American communities create a healthcare AI market where Spanish-English bilingual capability is not a premium feature but a baseline requirement. ClickMasters' bilingual AI capability is a standard Albuquerque healthcare AI deliverable.

blocks.heading: Tribal sovereignty and economic development
paragraphs: The Pueblo and Tribal nations of New Mexico are among the most economically significant sovereign governments in the US — gaming operations and diversified tribal enterprises create AI demand across casino analytics, hospitality management, and economic development planning that is both commercially significant and uniquely New Mexico.
